mismatch.message: unsupported hero command: dosacrifice() for the extended command 'offer' is not ported

summary: Worker B is implementing the complete dosacrifice command and its used-return floorfood/offer_ok selector dependency. The published mismatch remains step 124. Source review requires the complete floor-access, metal-eating and tinning branches as well as sacrifice selection before delivery; an independent command witness passes, but no new main score is claimed.

source.branch: The recorded extended command is the offer row with a normal command boundary. At pray.c:1860-1867, !on_altar() or u.uswallow takes the first refusal and Confusion or Stunned takes the second; this replay reaches the first arm with the hero at (45,17), tile typ 28 (ROOM), altarmask zero, swallowed false, and both status properties clear. The complete dosacrifice() scope then computes highaltar, calls floorfood('sacrifice', 1), returns ECMD_OK for no selected object, dispatches real and fake amulets and corpses, and emits nothing_happens for any other selected object.
callers: nethack-c/upstream/src/cmd.c:1775-1776 extcmdlist[] binds M('o') and the offer name to dosacrifice().
js/extcmdlist_data.js:89 reproduces the offer row; js/cmd.js:4887-5168 resolves and dispatches extended commands, but its default at 5164-5167 currently refuses dosacrifice().

nethack-c/upstream/src/iactions.c:472-482 queues dosacrifice() for the item-action sacrifice choice; js/iactions.js:568-578 queues the same handler, so the implementation must serve both the typed #offer route and item-action route.
dependencies: nethack-c/upstream/src/eat.c:3579-3730 floorfood() supplies dosacrifice()'s used return value. js/eat.js:2371-2446 implements only verb='eat', and explicitly raises UnsupportedEatError for corpsecheck/sacrifice, so the on-altar offering path remains blocked until the sacrifice selector is ported or handed off as a dependency.

nethack-c/upstream/src/pray.c:1446-1728 contains consume_offering(), offer_too_soon(), offer_real_amulet(), offer_negative_valued(), offer_fake_amulet(), offer_different_alignment_altar(), sacrifice_your_race(), and bestow_artifact(); pray.c:1959-2098 contains offer_corpse(). dosacrifice() uses the amulet and corpse helpers, whose JavaScript owners are not present as a complete offering path.

The guard arm uses existing source-shaped helpers: pray.c:105 on_altar() and :107 a_align(), plus youprop.h Levitation/Flying/Confusion/Stunned macros. js/pray.js already has on_altar()/a_align(), and js/trap.js:811-822 has Levitation()/Flying(); these are sufficient for the observed non-altar branch and do not consume RNG.

evidence: Current-main bounded replay run-DZt0zD, logged at /tmp/teleport-validation-1000/run-DZt0zD, replayed only sessions/holdout/seed0106-priest-extcmd-sweep.session.json at 18a56313c56723cde906c27449d0fc2c6c085bf0. The assigned recording's segments[0].steps[120-125] are the bytes #offer\n: steps 120-123 type the command, step 124 is the dispatching newline with C top line 'You are not on an altar.' and an empty RNG slice, and step 125 begins the next command. The step-124 cursor is [44,18,1], so the mismatch is the command result rather than a prompt answer.

nethack-c/upstream/src/pray.c:1852-1896 is the complete dosacrifice() body. Its first guard is source-deterministic: altar/swallow status selects the message, then Confusion/Stunned is checked, and only the later floorfood() call can ask for input or reach offering behavior.

Current JavaScript source confirms js/cmd.js:289 imports only dopray/doturn from pray.js and js/cmd.js:5162-5167 sends the offer row to the generic unsupported-command boundary. js/pray.js has no dosacrifice export. js/eat.js:2363-2370 documents that #offer/#tin are unported and js/eat.js:2376-2377 throws for the sacrifice call.
